places.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
places.ai_summary: A fairy-tale castle perched on a hill, inspiring Disney's Sleeping Beauty Castle.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas and New Year.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to avoid long queues.

places.name: Marienplatz (Munich)
places.ai_summary: The central square of Munich, featuring the New Town Hall and the famous Glockenspiel show.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Catch the Glockenspiel show at 11 AM or noon.

places.name: Zugspitze Mountain
places.ai_summary: Germany's highest peak, offering breathtaking views and year-round skiing opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Check weather conditions before visiting.

places.place_tip: Take the cable car for a quick ascent and enjoy the panoramic views.

places.name: Nymphenburg Palace
places.ai_summary: A magnificent Baroque palace with stunning gardens, once the summer residence of Bavarian kings.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from November to March.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the beautiful gardens and the Marstallmuseum.

places.name: Hofbräuhaus Beer Hall
places.ai_summary: Famous beer hall in Munich, known for its traditional Bavarian atmosphere and live music.
places.cost: Free entry, pay for what you consume

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for dinner.

places.place_tip: Try the pretzels and local beer specialties.

places.name: English Garden (Munich)
places.ai_summary: One of the largest urban parks in the world, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: Beer gardens within the park have their own hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Chinese Tower and the Japanese Tea House.

places.name: Bamberg Old Town
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, known for its well-preserved medieval architecture and charming canals.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the Little Venice and the Old Town Hall.

places.name: Nuremberg Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic castle offering panoramic views of Nuremberg and a glimpse into medieval history.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays from November to March.

places.place_tip: Visit the castle museum and enjoy the view from the balcony.

places.name: Oberammergau Village
places.ai_summary: A picturesque village known for its Passion Play, woodcarvings, and beautiful frescoed houses.

opening_hours.notes: Shops may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: See the famous Passion Play if visiting in the summer.

places.name: Eagle’s Nest (Kehlsteinhaus)
places.ai_summary: A historic site with stunning views, originally built as a retreat for Hitler.

opening_hours.notes: Closed from October to May.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the views.
